narrative_structure: The video follows a clear cause-and-effect arc: problem → solution → mechanism → benefit → trade-off. It begins by showing the inefficiency of a full table scan, introduces the index as a solution, explains how a B-tree structure enables fast search, demonstrates the final lookup, and concludes with the performance benefit and associated costs.
visual_concept_metaphor: A physical library catalog system. The database table is a long shelf of unordered books (rows). The index is a separate, alphabetically sorted card catalog (B-tree), where each card points to a book's shelf location. Searching via the catalog is dramatically faster than scanning every book.

visual_language_aesthetic_rules.philosophy: Chromatic Language. Color and spatial relationships are the primary information carriers. Typography is minimal and integrated as a visual element, not a paragraph. The design communicates through color zones, form, and composition.

zones.name: primary_action
zones.description: Main area for the table, index, and search animation.

zones.name: explanatory_text
zones.description: Centered, minimal text labels that anchor the visual story.

visual_hierarchy.focal_rule: The 1-2 focal elements are: (1) the target row in the table, and (2) the root of the B-tree index. All other elements are de-emphasized using muted colors and lower opacity.

representations.database_table: A horizontal row of 16 uniformly sized rectangles (representing rows), each 80x64px, spaced 20px apart, aligned on a single shelf-like line. Each has a unique ID (1-16) and a value label.
representations.rows: Rectangles with a thin ink stroke and white fill. The target row (ID=77) has an accent border and is slightly larger (88x72px) when highlighted.
representations.sequential_scan: A slow-moving, muted orange (muted) pointer that moves left-to-right across each row, pausing briefly on each.
representations.index_structure: A B-tree with 3 levels. Level 0 (root): 1 node. Level 1: 2 nodes. Level 2 (leaves): 4 nodes. Each node is a 120x64px rectangle with a thin ink stroke and white fill. The tree is balanced and symmetric.
representations.tree_search_narrowing: A path of search is animated by highlighting nodes in sequence, with a solid accent pointer moving from root to leaf. Eliminated branches are dimmed (ink @ 0.3).
representations.pointer_lookup_link: A solid accent line with an arrowhead that connects the leaf node in the index to the corresponding row in the table.
representations.performance_contrast: A split-screen comparison: left side shows the slow scan (many steps), right side shows the index lookup (3 steps). A large 'O(N)' vs 'O(log N)' callout is displayed.
representations.trade_offs: A small, muted inset panel in the corner lists 'Costs: Storage, Write Overhead, Maintenance' in sublabel typography.
